params.style_prompt: Convert to pixel art, flat colors, clean crisp pixels, limited palette

card.architecture: Qwen-Image-Edit (20B MMDiT) with per-step pixel-manifold projection — pixel art DIRECT from a reference
card.summary: Generates pixel art directly from a reference image: QIE redraws per the instruction while the projection clamps onto a fixed grid+palette every denoise step, so the model produces manifold-friendly structure instead of fighting a finished image. Virtual-resolution controls the sprite's pixel count independent of QIE's render bucket. API-only.
use_cases: pixel art directly from a character/reference image
instruction-guided pixel-art generation with enforced grid+palette
card.pick_when: You want pixel art generated from a reference in one pass, with the pixel grid enforced during generation.
